text: I went to a dentist to discuss getting braces, and I felt the dentist was very rude. They told me they didn't recommend braces and advised me to focus on improving my oral health first. They didn't give me a chance to discuss my concerns or explain my problems. They only focused on root canal treatment, which involves several teeth and sounds very expensive per tooth, not including other treatments. I couldn't afford it. After the consultation, the assistant calculated the estimated cost and said they didn't know how to give a proper estimate because it was so much. They also asked what I wanted done first. I decided not to proceed with the treatment at that clinic. I had a very negative experience. I know my teeth have significant problems, but I came to the dentist because I genuinely wanted treatment and that's why I sought advice. I didn't expect such a response. It's made me hesitant to see a dentist again and I don't want treatment because it's severely damaged my self-esteem.
